title: Hardship Settlement Signing Convention for Accounts With Returned Payments
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Returned-Payment Signing Convention

Returned consumer payments in the money history of a Placed Consumer Accounts record decide on which day the first payment of a Hardship Settlement of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements falls when the consumer accepts it by electronic signature.

**Convention.** The Hardship Settlement returned-payment signing convention decides on which day the first payment falls: where two or more consumer payments on the account were returned with a return date after the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date, the first payment is taken as guaranteed funds on the next business day after the acceptance date, Monday through Friday, and the adjusted signing window is set aside; where exactly one consumer payment on the account was returned in that span, the adjusted signing window is kept but a first payment that would fall due on a Saturday or a Sunday is moved back to the Friday before it, or forward to the Monday after it where that Friday would fall on or before the acceptance date; where none was returned in that span, the adjusted signing window is used as it stands, whatever day of the week it ends on.

The adjusted signing window is the signing window in calendar days as it stands after any shortening and any days added back; the convention yields the days from the acceptance date to the day the first payment falls.

## Input — judgement — output

| Returned consumer payments in the span | Output |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | first payment on the next business day after acceptance, as guaranteed funds |
| exactly 1 | adjusted window kept; a Saturday or Sunday due day moves to the Friday before, or to the Monday after where that Friday falls on or before the acceptance date |
| none | adjusted window as it stands |

## Hypothetical cases

- Two returns, signature on a Wednesday: first payment Thursday, 1 day. Signature on a Friday: Monday, 3 days.
- One return, signature on a Tuesday, adjusted window 26 days ending on a Sunday: moved back to the Friday, 24 days.
- One return, signature on a Friday, adjusted window 2 days ending on the Sunday: the Friday before is the signing day itself, so the payment moves forward to the Monday, 3 days.
- One return, signature on a Saturday, adjusted window 1 day ending on the Sunday: the Friday before falls before the signing day, so the payment moves forward to the Monday, 2 days.
- No return, adjusted window ending on a Saturday: the Saturday stands.
